objective: Measure the clock-512 force-grid correction delta=U(N384,M512)-U(N384,M384) on the same unshifted M768 physical lattice and five exclusive sampled regions as the archived M384 analytical-reference diagnostic.
claims_excluded: state import, resume, injection or evolution

archived_m384_reference_context.use: Immutable context only. Do not resample the analytical field and do not interpret the scalar norm bounds as vector alignment evidence.

computation: Before state access, hash and validate both manifests, both frozen plans, exact profiles, pair semantics, file lengths, CPU/memory gates, executable hash and external address-space limit.

Decode and verify both state files into separate owned snapshots. From immutable coefficient borrows allocate a third retained-grid vector delta_hat=right_M512-left_M384; rehash both source coefficient vectors before dropping them, then hash-bind delta_hat.

Build one M768 u8 label array. Recompute the exact clock-512 masks with one q(z) root per eligible z plane and the same binary64 operation order as regions::classify; only 461 of 768 z planes require q, capped at 59008 root iterations total. Verify the five counts exactly match the archived count vector. A future hash-bound label sidecar may replace this pass.

Use one FftCatalog and one DerivativeWorkspace::new_from_catalog on delta_hat. Sample the same component-major velocity, gradient and ordered-Hessian schedule sequentially: exactly 39 inverse transforms.

Reuse one f64 array to accumulate Euclidean/Frobenius magnitude across each quantity components, then reduce it globally and over the cached five-class labels before clearing it for the next quantity.
Rehash delta_hat after all transforms. Emit one bounded transactional JSON result with both source bindings, delta hash, counts, RMS/peak rows, triangle context and explicit non-claims.

triangle_inequality_context.interpretation: These are norm bounds on the unknown M512 analytical-reference error. They make no claim about vector alignment, cancellation, pointwise sign, or whether M512 is closer to the reference.
triangle_inequality_context.floors: Carry the archived per-quantity floors unchanged as scale metadata. If peak/floor is emitted, label it peak_over_archived_floor; never label it analytical relative error.

reusable_code.use: pair-contract template; helper visibility or harness-local exact validator is required
39 AVX inverse samples on the retained difference spectrum
RMS/peak reduction with archived floors; expose only correction norms and clearly named floor scaling
mask oracle and parity test for the z-table classifier
at most 461 mask-only q(z) solves, never an analytical field evaluation
component ordering, label reduction and output pattern; remove PackedReference/reference arrays

missing_adapter_glue: A strict two-manifest force-pair binder for the exact M384/M512 manifests; the regional harness currently binds only M384 and compare::validate_force_manifests is private and expects FORCE_RESOLUTION_DIAGNOSTIC manifests.
A checked difference-spectrum constructor from immutable source borrows plus before/drop and after-measurement hashes.
A z-table M768 label builder that is parity-tested against regions::classify and refuses unless counts equal the archived five-class vector.
A correction norm output type that names delta RMS/peak and optional peak_over_archived_floor without implying analytical reference or vector alignment.
A triangle-bound join keyed by quantity and region against the hash-bound archived clock0512 JSON.
A new explicit command and launch gate; no state import/resume/evolution interface.

storage.phase_max: measurement phase; both source snapshots must be dropped before catalog/workspace allocation

runtime_estimate.basis: The archived one-state 39-transform regional run took about 1909 seconds. Its x-plane pilot projected about 853 seconds for the removed 452984832 analytical-reference evaluations. The residual about 1056 seconds covers decode, 39 transforms, reductions, coverage and serialization; add a second decode, difference construction/hash and cheap label pass, then retain roughly 250 seconds margin below the 1800-second timeout.
runtime_estimate.uncertainty: The prior run did not record phase timestamps, so the subtraction is a planning estimate rather than a measured transform-only timing.

validation_before_any_reviewed_run: Unit-test right-minus-left sign and all 39 component/derivative mappings on small analytic spectra.
Test one-byte-short refusal for the 16431131744-byte internal cap and exact 20 GiB RLIMIT_AS gate.

Compare the z-table classifier against regions::classify on the full x=0 plane and representative cutoff/interior/collar coordinates; require the eventual full five-class counts to equal the archived vector.
Test triangle-bound arithmetic and names so no field is called a reference error or acceptance result.
Run cargo fmt, cargo clippy -D warnings and unit tests only. Require a separate root review and fresh resource admission before any payload read or full execution.
